scenario.description: A director must decide whether to approve an employee's requested move from the Customer Support pod to Platform Enablement and finalize the reporting boundary, transition date, onboarding support, and interpersonal safeguards.

shared_context.S1: Nadia has requested an internal move from the Customer Support pod to the Platform Enablement team.
shared_context.S2: Elise makes the final decision about the transfer and its implementation plan.
shared_context.S3: The transfer would affect Nadia's reporting line, current-team handoff, and onboarding into the receiving team.
shared_context.S4: The department's standard internal-transfer review includes input from the employee, the current manager, the receiving manager, and HR before the final decision is recorded.
shared_context.S5: During the routine review, Elise asks the employee, current manager, receiving manager, and HR to describe any concrete condition, date, readiness requirement, or procedural safeguard they recommend for the transfer.
shared_context.S6: The transfer plan normally records the employee's reporting line, release date, receiving-team onboarding requirements, and any HR safeguards before approval.

PF1.text: Nadia told a colleague that she will accept the move only if she reports directly to Hannah and has no one-to-one meetings with Victor for the first 30 days after the move; she has not put this condition in the transfer request because she worries it will be treated as insubordination.

PF2.text: Victor promised Nadia in a one-to-one that, if the transfer is approved, he would release her from the Support pod effective June 3, 2025; the promise was not added to the transfer request.

PF3.text: Hannah's review of Nadia's recent case work showed that Nadia needs exactly two shadowing sessions on platform-escalation handling before taking independent escalations; Hannah has not yet added that observation to the receiving-team onboarding plan.

PF4.text: Marcus confirmed this week that an internal transfer following a strained reporting relationship requires a neutral HR review meeting and a written non-retaliation acknowledgment before the transfer is finalized; the requirement has not yet been attached to this request.

acceptance_conditions: The transfer must be approved into Platform Enablement.
Nadia must report to Hannah after the move.
The transfer must take effect on June 3, 2025.
One-to-one meetings between Nadia and Victor must be prohibited for the first 30 days after the move.
The onboarding plan must include exactly two platform-escalation shadowing sessions.
A neutral HR review meeting and written non-retaliation acknowledgment must be required before finalization.

content_checks.C2: decisions['transfer_destination'] == 'Platform Enablement' or decisions['transfer_destination'] == 'Platform Enablement team'
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'release_date' and 'Support pod' in c['detail'] and ('June 3, 2025' in c['detail'] or '2025-06-03' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any((c['type'] == 'reporting_confirmation' or c['type'] == 'reporting_line') and (c['target'] == 'Nadia' or c['target'] == 'Hannah') for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed
provenance_checks.P4: 'PF4' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF4' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Nadia's stated condition changes the destination to Platform Enablement, changes the boundary to prohibit one-to-ones with Victor, and requires a reporting confirmation that Nadia reports directly to Hannah.
Victor's promise fixes the effective date at June 3, 2025 and requires a release-date commitment stating Nadia's departure from the Support pod on that date.
Hannah's readiness observation changes the onboarding plan to exactly two platform-escalation shadowing sessions.
Marcus's confirmed requirement changes the transfer safeguards to require both a neutral HR review meeting and a written non-retaliation acknowledgment.
